inference.coverage_basis: exact global unique token membership and identity/payload hashes, including successful prior attempts
inference.routing: independent GPU processes with small work leases, exact full-input identity and original scene-bound noise

limits: GPU_hours is summed worker inference wall time /3600, including sleeps/gaps; not CUDA kernel time or exclusive device billing. Model staging/qualification/export costs are additional. CPU scoring overlaps inference and must not be added as serial time.
